shared_elements: human face/head imagery (glyph elements in A include stylized faces in profile)
justification: A is a dense grid of rounded, block-like script signs arranged in ordered columns and rows, some containing small stylized profile heads, while B is a single frontal human face with a stepped headdress, rendered as a sculptural portrait with naturalistic eyes, nose and mouth. Beyond the incidental presence of stylized human facial features in both, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement; the organizing logic (repeating text-like blocks vs one isolated frontal mask) is entirely different.
